{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cularin Pirates''' were a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dorel-Kan]] became a high-ranking member of the Cularin Pirates, and he developed a close working relationship with his fellow pirate [[Reeayah]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Force Adept]]. During the [[Confederation Rock Rush]], the Cularin Pirates and their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] were present in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], and Reeayah used the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to allow them to track the ''[[Neeva-Beelo]]'', which the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] viewed as a potential target. The ''Beelo'' docked inside an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], so Dorel-Kan, Reeayah and ten other pirates landed on the rock and attacked the ''Beelo''{{'s}} crew, the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
